newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper editorials - July 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper editorials - July 25.

text.p: These are highlights of comments in the Hong Kong press. The views expressed are those of the newspapers quoted and do not represent an editorial viewpoint of Reuters.

-- MING PAO said the government should make stricter rules regarding retired senior government officials going into business. The paper said it was important to keep the civil service team clean and independent from the influence of the commercial sector.

-- The Beijing-funded TA KUNG PAO said China would continue to carry out the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics, created by the late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping. It said the reforms and open-door policy will also remain, and the "one country, two systems" policy on Hong Kong was part of Deng's overall strategy.

-- The English-language HONGKONG STANDARD said it would be a positive development if Hong Kong became a centre for Chinese books. It said Hong Kong could and should strengthen this role by having a more positive effect on Chinese culture as a whole, not just on the so-called "pop culture".
